trade_signal_doctrine.entry_logic: Preemptive entry at predicted wick-rejection zone (defensive staff) with tight SL; no waiting for confirmation.
confluences: Confluence 1: ICT/SMC, Supply & Demand, and Trend Indicators. The H4 trend is strongly bullish, supported by the HTF EMA50/200. Price has retraced into a major H4 demand zone (80120 - 80400) and swept sell-side liquidity below the 80263.66 level down to 80165.49, mitigating the unmitigated order block before displacing upwards.

Confluence 2: MSNR, Candlestick Patterns, and Volatility Indicators. A Malaysian SNR level at 80165.49 aligns with the H1/M15 long lower wick-rejections (pin bars). The M15 ATR(14) of 126.24 indicates sufficient volatility to drive a rapid preemptive bounce off this defensive staff zone, rejecting the lower Bollinger Band.

Confluence 3: CRT, Quarter Theory, and Momentum Indicators. Candle Range Theory (CRT) shows accumulation at the lower boundary of the daily range. This aligns with the Quarter Theory major level at 80000 and minor level at 80250. The M15 RSI(14) at 49.3 is recovering from near-oversold territory, indicating a bullish momentum shift.

Confluence 4: BOS, FVG, and Volume Indicators. The M5/M15 structure shows a minor Break of Structure (BOS) to the upside as price cleared 80400. This displacement left a bullish Fair Value Gap (FVG) between 80267.89 and 80382.01. Qualitative volume analysis suggests rising buying volume (A/D and OBV ticking up) on the latest bullish candles.

Confluence 5: Chart Patterns, Fibonacci Retracement, and Standard Deviation. A clear double bottom pattern has formed on the H1 timeframe at 80126.04 and 80165.49. This zone aligns perfectly with the 0.618 Fibonacci retracement level of the HTF impulse leg and sits at -2 Standard Deviations from the mean, signaling an exhausted corrective phase ready for expansion.
